findings.title: State and enum columns are unconstrained free text at the database layer

evidence.quote: status String @default("NOT")
0 CHECK constraints exist for status, payment method, rating ranges, or amount sign.

findings.impact: Any client bug or manual write can persist invalid states (status=COMPLEETD, payment=Bitcoin, selfRating=9) that the UI and cron scoring then misinterpret silently; the constraint lives only in scattered runtime checks.
findings.fix: Add CHECK constraints via a migration (status IN ('NOT','PARTIAL','COMPLETED'), payment IN ('UPI','Cash','Card'), selfRating BETWEEN 1 AND 5, amount >= 0) and mirror them as zod enums at the edge.
findings.verify: rg -c CHECK prisma/migrations latest migration expects >=3

findings.title: Money columns use Float instead of integer minor units or Decimal

evidence.quote: amount    Float
allowance Float    @default(0)

findings.impact: Currency sums accumulate binary floating-point error (0.1+0.2 class) in exactly the budget-vs-spending comparisons the finance module exists for; the check catalog marks floating-point money a hard-cap defect, calibrated here to High because the flows are display-grade single-user records with no settlement or reconciliation against external money.
findings.fix: Migrate amount/allowance to Decimal @db.Decimal(12,2) (or integer paise), convert at the client boundary, and round sums with decimal-safe helpers.
findings.verify: rg -n Float prisma/schema.prisma within Finance models expects 0

evidence.quote: 0 hits: a stuck query or leaked transaction holds its lock until the platform kills the request.

findings.impact: One pathological query (e.g. the unbounded finance scan) or a crashed request mid-transaction can pin connections and stall every other route on a small Supabase pool.
findings.fix: Append connection_limit and pool_timeout to DATABASE_URL and set statement_timeout and idle_in_transaction_session_timeout (e.g. 15s/30s) via Supabase role defaults.

findings.title: Cumulative counters and bill-payment pairs update non-atomically
findings.impact: Two overlapping tracker submissions lose hours (read-modify-write race), and a failure between bill payment and expense booking leaves a paid bill with no expense row - silent money-record corruption.
findings.fix: Use Prisma update with atomic increment syntax (hoursStudied: { increment: hours }) and wrap bill-pay in prisma.$transaction.
